findings: `historical_glyphs.items[0].caption` and `selection_reason` present the attached seal-script image as a clear example showing the pictographic depiction, but the inspected pixels and glyph evidence support only its identification as a modern redraw of the Shuowen Small Seal tradition; they do not establish that the rounded outline and inner strokes show meat or that this image demonstrates the character’s pictographic origin. Describe the redraw and its visible form without treating those details as evidence of the depicted referent.
